title: The Ribbon Hero Anime Film Reveals Teaser Trailer, Main Cast, August 8 Debut
content: Netflix revealed on Tuesday a teaser trailer, key art visual, main voice actor , and August 8 worldwide debut for it and Twin Engine 's new anime film The Ribbon Hero based on Osamu Tezuka 's Princess Knight ( Ribbon no Kishi ) manga. Saya of comedy duo Lalande stars as Sapphire.

title: 'The Ribbon Hero' Reveals Lead Cast, Additional Staff, Trailer
content: The official website for The Ribbon Hero original anime movie revealed the lead cast, additional staff, a key visual (pictured right), and the first trailer on Tuesday. The anime movie based on Osamu Tezuka 's Ribbon no Kishi manga is scheduled to premiere worldwide exclusively on Netflix on August 8.

title: Magilumiere Magical Girls Season 2 Reveals New Trailer, Cast, Ending Theme Song
content: Magilumiere Magical Girls Season 2 revealed a new trailer, Hitomi Koshigaya’s voice actress, and one new cast member, and the ending theme song. Mariko Higashiuchi is the new voice of Hitomi Koshigaya (replacing Yumiri Hanamori) and Sayumi Watabe joins the cast as Iroha Akasaka.

title: I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand Reveals New Key Visual, Additional Cast
content: The upcoming I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand anime has revealed a new key visual ahead of its July 2026 release. Studio GEKKOU is in charge of the animation, with Hiroyuki Kanbe as the director.
